rows.grounds: compound of śatakratu (Indra), tanu (body), aprameya (immeasurable), and atha (then); final o'tha shows sandhi before atha
adjective derived from vīrya (vigor) with possessive suffix -vān

items.question: Which divine form is described as immeasurable and endowed with vigor?
premises: The form is endowed with vigor.
items.inference: The verse identifies a mighty divine form.
items.plain_english: Then the immeasurable Indra-bodied one, endowed with vigor.
